prompt.text:
Implement a pure byte encoder for a legacy text-cell display in `solution.rs`, using only the Rust standard library and no assembly.

Expose:

- `pub enum CellError { NonPrintable { byte_index: usize }, TooLong }`
- `pub fn encode_banner(text: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, CellError>`

Each accepted input byte must be printable ASCII in the inclusive range `0x20..=0x7e`. Encode every character as two bytes: the character byte followed by attribute byte `0xf3`. Return `NonPrintable` with the UTF-8 byte index of the first rejected byte. Accept an empty string. Reject more than `u16::MAX` characters with `TooLong`, checking this before allocating the result. The input must remain unchanged and output order must match input order.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
